newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall despite export deals.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall despite export deals.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Thursday fell to 1,187/1,188 rupees per quintal from 1,193/1,194 rupees despite reports of fresh export deals, dealers said.
"Reports that Indian exporters have finalised export deals of about 3,000 tonnes of castoroil at the rate of 706 dollars per tonne failed to cheer market sentiment," a dealer said.
Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region also rose to 28,000/30,000 bags (75 kg each) which softened the market sentiments.

Groundnut oil looked up by 1/2 at 339/340 rupees per 10 kg on limited arrivals of 40/50 tonnes coupled with fresh physical support. Imported palm oil on the other hand slid by a rupee at 275/276 rupees per 10 kg amid sluggish outstation buying and reports of expected arrivals at the Bombay port.
Rajkot spot groundnut oil rose from 514/515 rupees to 517/518 rupees per 15 kg.
